We’ll be sharing even more new features designed to boost your creative career in the new year. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">We can’t wait to see what you’ll create in 2025. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/bb68aa41-6156-4d51-9395-e64cf07445ac.png?width=2362&height=1386&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Best of 2024\"><\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Browse top projects from this year in our <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/moodboard\/214976895\/2024\">Best of 2024 moodboard<\/a>. <\/p>"},{"id":1822,"slug":"visual-trends-2024","title":"Top 3 Visual Trends of 2024 ","updatedOn":"2024-12-10T15:49:47.395Z","publishedOn":"2024-12-10T13:00:00.000Z","summary":"We analyzed top Behance projects from 2024 to identify the most influential visual trends that shaped the world of design this year.","status":"published","keywords":[],"categories":[{"label":"Inspiration","slug":"inspiration"}],"featuredImage":{"author":"The Behance Team ","authorUrl":"https:\/\/behance.net\/behance","sourceProject":"Top 3 Visual Trends of 2024 ","sourceProjectUrl":null,"behanceUrl":null,"id":"a6513307-926c-486e-8e24-fb2bf31491e5","imageUrl":"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/a6513307-926c-486e-8e24-fb2bf31491e5?format=webp&quality=90","alt":"The Behance Team : Top 3 Visual Trends of 2024 "},"content":"<p dir=\"ltr\">Over the last two decades, Behance has become the leading platform for over 55 million diverse and global creatives to showcase their work, discover talent, and find inspiration across every discipline. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">As the year comes to a close, we’ve analyzed top performing Behance projects spanning graphic design, photography, illustration, 3D art, and beyond, to identify the most influential visual trends that shaped the world of design in 2024. <\/p>\n<h2>1. Electric Pink<\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/d58a1bad-8dc9-4c61-ab9a-a2437df0f1bd.png?width=2362&height=1566&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Electric Pink\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/moodboard\/215277465\/Electric-Pink\"> Electric Pink moodboard<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">In 2024, Electric Pink emerged as a dominant color trend, captivating designers and audiences alike with its bold and electrifying presence. This vibrant shade was often used in branding and packaging designs, as well as illustration projects to add an instant dose of energy. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Symbolizing boldness and confidence, Electric Pink radiates a youthful, rebellious spirit that resonated deeply with the year's creative ethos, pushing boundaries and encouraging experimentation.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/b7e19517-a3b8-42be-b822-b632a4395612.png?width=1400&height=1285&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Cihy\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/191486173\/%08CIHY(Caffeine-I-Hate-You)-Brand-Identity-Packaging\">CIHY(Caffeine I Hate You) by AURG DESIGN, Song yee Paek, and Jintaek Park<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">“Electric pink brings a unique energy to design. It conveys boldness, modernity, and movement, and carries a positive emotional charge that gives a sense of lightness and excitement,” says graphic designer <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/galobato\">Gabriel Lobato<\/a>. In his branding design for film company <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/192516097\/Capivara-Films-Brand-Identity\">Capivara<\/a>, Gabriel leaned on Electric Pink to build the image of a dynamic company. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">“We needed a color that would make the brand stand out and reinforce its modern and vibrant identity. ElectricPpink was the perfect choice to translate this desire to differentiate completely, breaking away from the more sober and traditional colors typically used in the audiovisual industry,” he explains. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><iframe title=\"vimeo-player\" src=\"https:\/\/player.vimeo.com\/video\/922075409?h=783be6eca5\" width=\"640\" height=\"360\" frameborder=\"0\" allowfullscreen=\"allowfullscreen\"><\/iframe><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/192516097\/Capivara-Films-Brand-Identity\">Capivara Films – Brand Identity by Gabriel Lobato<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">“I like to create characters with unusual, unusual expressions, so strong colors help to elevate the content,” says illustrator <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/luciapham\">Lucia Pham<\/a>. Electric Pink is one of her favorites. “It can be paired with pastels to create dreamy pieces, or paired with other high-contrast colors to create a powerful, memorable effect.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">For her K-pop inspired illustrations, Lucia combined the striking hue with vibrant primary colors for a fun and energetic vibe. According to Lucia, the key to harnessing the power of Electric Pink is balance. \"Because it’s a bright and strong color, if overused or in the wrong place, it will make the viewer feel dizzy and not want to look at it for too long,” she advises.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/fa1fcbb2-21d7-4247-a7b9-647a3edbb8fc.gif?width=1200&height=675&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Lucia\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/188512249\/Illustration-Collection-I-2024\">Illustration Collection I-2024 by Lucia Pham<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/moodboard\/215277465\/Electric-Pink\">See the Electric Pink moodboard<\/a><\/p>\n<h2>2. Earthencraft <\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/242546df-8e0b-4ad8-8fa1-4d730e2f5012.png?width=2646&height=1550&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Earthenware\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/moodboard\/214977575\/Earthencraft\"> Earthencraft moodboard<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">In contrast to high-octane Electric Pink, the Earthencraft trend embraced a return to nature and grounded aesthetics. Drawing inspiration from the earth, designers leaned into organic shapes, earthy tones, and natural textures to create designs that evoke warmth, authenticity, and a deep connection to the natural world. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Sustainability and the desire for a connection to the earth guided creative choices within the Earthencraft trend. By embracing the beauty of imperfection and the uniqueness of natural materials, Earthencraft encouraged a more sustainable and holistic approach to design.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/cadb39e2-1f85-4ca1-920a-3cabcde0fee1.png?width=1920&height=1350&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Oaku\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/194191453\/Oaku-Logo-Brand-Product-Design\">Oaku | Logo, Brand & Product Design by Pedro Garcia and Xorokê Creative Studio<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">For the branding of Los Altos tequila, the team at <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/hiestudio\">HI! ESTUDIO<\/a> looked to the land for inspiration. “The land of Los Altos has a unique reddish color. It is difficult to find elsewhere in the world,” explain Gabriel Cuevas and Alan Aguiñaga, the founders of HI! ESTUDIO. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">This connection to the earth is further emphasized in the materials: “The color of the glass comes from recycled materials, and the label is designed to be locally produced within the community, using recycled materials.” For Gabriel and Alan, the turn towards sustainability transcends the trend: “It’s a current necessity. Packaging must adopt this direction for the sake of sustainability and in response to contemporary environmental challenges.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/ee3a5cff-5059-4c66-ab59-e6bc3b4bf5c3.png?width=3840&height=2160&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Labroso\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/203940099\/LABROSO-TEQUILA\">LABROSO TEQUILA by HI! ESTUDIO<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Earthencraft not only emphasizes sustainability but also fosters a deep, instinctual connection between the viewer and the artwork. “Earthy and grounded visuals create a sense of warmth and grounding, allowing the viewer to connect with the art in an instinctive and emotional way,” says graphic designer <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/damiaogiovani\">Damião Giovani<\/a>.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">When creating the branding for art gallery <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/193755513\/ABSTRATO\">Ābstrato<\/a>, Damião and his collaborators incorporated “organic shapes, textures, colors and images that evoke the essence of nature” to invite the visitors to represent the gallery as “a refuge where art meets the soul, inviting the spectator to lose themselves in its layers of meaning.” <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/f94f2461-1e72-41ca-82f5-0017c1e70d1d.png?width=1400&height=788&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Abstrato\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/193755513\/ABSTRATO\">ĀBSTRATO by Damião Giovani, Guilherme Sampaio, Mariane Farias, and D\/Design Studio<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Damião predicts that the appeal of organic, earthy aesthetics will only grow in an increasingly digital world. “We believe that the Earthencraft style will play an essential role in the future of design, especially in a world where the search for visual experiences that promote reconnection with nature intensifies.” <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/moodboard\/214977575\/Earthencraft\">See the Earthencraft moodboard<\/a><\/p>\n<h2>3. Translucency<\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/3c705b74-53f0-4da3-aeee-c6117bb5bd19.png?width=2358&height=1574&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Translucency\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/moodboard\/215277723\/Translucency\">Translucency moodboard<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Translucency emerged as a defining theme in 3D art and digital compositions throughout 2024.  Artists harnessed the power of overlapping layers of semi-transparent shapes to create a sense of depth, lightness, and fluidity in their work, often creating ethereal, dream-like visuals. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">“The layers that a translucent material creates, usually blur details, but surprises our mind like a spark, catching our eyes with unexpected  and dreamy results, stimulating our imagination.” says director and digital artist Leonardo Betti, who goes by <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/leonardoworx\">Leonardoworx<\/a> on Behance. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/ccf8471c-16fa-4e89-92d0-49318112c42d.jpg?width=2560&height=2560&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Leonardo\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/leonardoworx\">ONE OF A KIND by Leonardoworx LWX<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Leonardo’s project <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/194350419\/ONE-OF-A-KIND\">One of a Kind<\/a> is an expression of his moods: “In each composition, all the elements, shapes, textures, materials and color palettes were chosen spontaneously in order to enhance the feelings I had to express.” By adding translucency to the 3D elements, Leonardo was able to create more depth and a sense of playfulness. “Like a kid that observes life in movement through a crystal or behind a curtain,” he says. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Translucent elements also added an extra layer of intrigue to motion projects, where they interacted with light and movement to create captivating multidimensional effects. Translucency showcased the power of digital tools to create both striking visuals and enchanting motion experiences.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><video controls=\"controls\" width=\"300\" height=\"150\"><source src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/fc51b64a-e560-4414-b7b6-5c5c347940b5&format=webp&quality=90\" type=\"video\/mp4\"><\/video><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/188421529\/Root-node-problems-Visualising-AI\">Root node problems by Jesper Lindborg and DeepMind Design<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">“The gentle way light passes through creates a soothing, almost ethereal feel that can evoke emotions like calmness or wonder,” says 3D artist and director <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/jesperlindborg\">Jesper Lindborg<\/a>. “When done right, it adds an air of beauty and intrigue, keeping viewers engaged and connected to the visuals.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">For Jesper, translucent layers add a “magical touch” to his project visualizing AI: “They scatter light softly within the objects, creating natural glows, diffused shadows, and amplifying colors. I love how they gently illuminate surroundings, adding depth and revealing hidden details. Their dynamic interaction with light creates a smooth and sometimes dream-like atmosphere that makes scenes come alive.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/moodboard\/215277723\/Translucency\">See the Translucency moodboard<\/a><\/p>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">Best of Behance 2024 <\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Explore the top projects from Behance in our <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/moodboard\/214976895\/2024\">Best of 2024<\/a> moodboard. We’re excited to see all the inspiring creative work you'll share in the coming year!<\/p>\n<p><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/39145116-c652-40ab-9a69-66290a4c0758.png?width=2362&height=1386&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Best of 2024\"><\/p>"},{"id":1823,"slug":"pricing-guidance","title":"Introducing Pricing Guidance: Helping You Price Your Work with Confidence","updatedOn":"2025-02-11T21:06:58.524Z","publishedOn":"2024-12-09T15:00:00.000Z","summary":"Learn how to best price your work based on creatives offering similar services and data-driven insights with our newest feature on Behance Pro. Here are some of the latest features we’ve launched. <\/p>\n<ul>\n<li dir=\"ltr\" aria-level=\"1\">\n<p dir=\"ltr\" role=\"presentation\">Access to more opportunities: Get matched with the latest freelance projects that align with your skill set and availability.<\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li dir=\"ltr\" aria-level=\"1\">\n<p dir=\"ltr\" role=\"presentation\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/blog\/profile-customizations\">Profile customizations<\/a>: Personalize your profile page by adding sections, a custom button, enabling dark theme, and more. <\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li dir=\"ltr\" aria-level=\"1\">\n<p dir=\"ltr\" role=\"presentation\">0% Platform fees: Save money every time you get paid for a freelance project or sell a digital asset. 0% fees also extend to your clients. <\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li dir=\"ltr\" aria-level=\"1\">\n<p dir=\"ltr\" role=\"presentation\">Advanced analytics: See who’s interacting with your work and where they are coming from, top search terms and traffic sources to optimize your portfolio. <\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li dir=\"ltr\" aria-level=\"1\">\n<p dir=\"ltr\" role=\"presentation\">Advanced project settings: Password protect your projects or make them shareable by link only, and schedule projects to publish automatically. <\/p>\n<\/li>\n<li dir=\"ltr\" aria-level=\"1\">\n<p dir=\"ltr\" role=\"presentation\">Additional benefits including <a href=\"https:\/\/portfolio.adobe.com\/\">Adobe Portfolio<\/a>, a Pro badge, search by image, and more. <\/p>\n<\/li>\n<\/ul>\n<p><video controls=\"controls\" width=\"300\" height=\"150\"><source src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/df232b4f-a2c9-4b5f-a0f7-9dc48c50d4b4&format=webp&quality=90\" type=\"video\/mp4\"><\/video><\/p>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">Hire Talent with Freelance Projects  <\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Looking to hire talent? Review the portfolios and connect with qualified candidates, and complete the payment for the work safely and securely on Behance. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/734e5521-7241-47a9-b350-70d731d77dc0.jpg?width=3840&height=2880&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Lalit2\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/207577957\/Gradient-Art\">Gradient Art by Lalit<\/a><\/h4>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">Get Paid Directly on Behance<\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/blog\/paypal\">Connect your PayPal or Stripe account<\/a> to Behance to get paid directly and securely on platform for your freelance services, assets, and subscriptions, and to be recommended to hirers who are looking for talent.<\/p>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">Looking Ahead<\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">We have even more exciting features in the works, including pricing guidelines to help creatives get paid fairly, an AI hiring assistant to help hirers quickly and efficiently find freelancers, and exclusive partnerships to bring more opportunities to our community. Follow us on<a href=\"http:\/\/instagram.com\/behance\"> Instagram<\/a> and<a href=\"http:\/\/twitter.com\/behance\"> X<\/a> to get the latest updates on feature releases. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/pro\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/a10d43e6-6de3-454e-9998-d55b31897190.png?width=2106&height=399&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Blog Banner\"><\/a><\/p>"},{"id":1820,"slug":"power-of-mentorship","title":"The Power of Mentorship: Why Every Creative Needs a Mentor ","updatedOn":"2024-10-01T18:59:44.812Z","publishedOn":"2024-10-01T18:43:00.000Z","summary":"Discover the transformative impact of mentorship on your creative career and learn why having a mentor is essential for success.","status":"published","keywords":[],"categories":[{"label":"Tips and Tutorials","slug":"tips-and-tutorials"}],"featuredImage":{"author":" Stefan Fdtn","authorUrl":"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/Fdtn","sourceProject":"Shapes","sourceProjectUrl":"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/51671091\/Shapes","behanceUrl":null,"id":"51dd9cd8-510b-4059-a608-45508995b74b","imageUrl":"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/51dd9cd8-510b-4059-a608-45508995b74b?format=webp&quality=90","alt":" Stefan Fdtn: Shapes"},"content":"<p dir=\"ltr\">Whether you're a freelance designer, illustrator, or an aspiring art director, navigating your career alone can be daunting. A mentor provides guidance, support, and insights that can help accelerate both your professional and personal growth. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">In this article, we explore why every creative needs a mentor, featuring insights from three artists who have experienced mentorship from both sides.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/b16d2b9c-b160-463b-848d-917ed8327dbe.png?width=3840&height=2322&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Stefan4\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/106944483\/OP-2-shapeshift\">OP 2 | shapeshift by Stefan Fdtn<\/a><\/h4>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">Mentorship Provides Clarity and Direction<\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Reaching a crossroads in your career can be daunting. A mentor often holds the key to unlocking the clarity and direction you need to move forward. \"A good mentor equips you with the tools to help you focus, clarify your goals, and take the next steps in your growth. A great mentor can often identify your needs before you're even fully aware of them yourself,” says illustrator and mentor <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/thebluehorsech\">Teti Kartasheva<\/a>. <\/p>\n<p>Connecting with more experienced individuals in your field allows you to learn from their successes and mistakes. Illustrator and creative director <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/david_sossella\/\">David Sossella<\/a> shares, \"The importance of a mentor lies in their ability to pass on their experience.\" David naturally assumed the role of mentor as friends and colleagues sought his advice, realizing he could help others grow by sharing his insights. “This made me realize that I could help others with my experience and share what I had learned and discovered.”<\/p>\n<p style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/9394ab79-1dbd-423c-9ce4-4d3e2bfeebc2.jpg?width=1400&height=1030&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Teti\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/96866823\/Illustrations-for-an-Art-Studio\">Illustrations for an Art Studio by Teti Kartasheva<\/a><\/h4>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">Mentorship Offers Tailored Feedback<\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">While books, tutorials, and online resources are beneficial, nothing compares to personalized, one-on-one feedback. \"Where a mentor can make a real difference is by personally guiding you, looking at your work, and tailoring their advice specifically to it,\" explains David. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Mentors invest time to understand your vision and goals, providing feedback that can help refine your portfolio and make it more appealing to potential clients or employers. They can spot gaps in your work and suggest areas for improvement, helping you explore new creative possibilities and push the boundaries of your craft.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/ac491f36-1b2e-4d2d-a87f-265804cdf6ad.jpg?width=3840&height=5376&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Daiv3\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/115887647\/NFT-isometric-illustrations\">NFT isometric illustrations by David Sossella<\/a><\/h4>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">Mentorship Can Come from Anywhere<\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Mentorship doesn't always have to follow a formal mentor-mentee structure. Throughout your career, you can find mentors in various forms and settings. “At the beginning, it can be a friend or colleague who shares the same hobby as you, someone who you can turn to for feedback or just questions in general,” explains visual designer <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/Fdtn\">Stefan Balasoiu<\/a>. Informal connections can provide valuable insights and support, helping you to grow and develop your skills in a more relaxed environment. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Plus with social media and platforms like Behance, geographic barriers no longer exist. You can reach out to mentors from the opposite side of the world and build relationships virtually. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/d00ec730-539a-4adc-b028-5f6acc1e96da.png?width=3840&height=3843&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Stefan\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/182705503\/Sound-Sculpture-Free-\">Sound Sculpture by Stefan Fdtn<\/a><\/h4>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">Mentorships Can be Short and Long Term <\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">While long-term mentorships can be incredibly rewarding, don’t be discouraged if a mentorship doesn’t develop into a lasting relationship. “Don’t underestimate the value of a brief interaction — it can be extremely impactful,” Teti notes. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">As a mentee, Teti proactively reached out to professionals in her field when she needed guidance. “Some of these relationships have developed into lasting connections, while others were short and straightforward. A few mentorships may not have been as effective as I imagined, but they still provided me with some insights for my next steps,” she recalls. “I’m confident that I wouldn’t be where I am today without all those encounters, and I’m very grateful for each one of them.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/73e11bd0-d970-4efe-8e9e-f45adcfc8e21.png?width=1400&height=1750&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Teti\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/185926269\/Enchanted-Garden-Illustrations\">Enchanted Garden Illustrations by Teti Kartasheva<\/a><\/h4>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">Mentorship Provides Emotional Support<\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Being a creative is not just about honing your technical skills—it’s also about overcoming emotional challenges like self-doubt and creative block. Mentors provide crucial support during these difficult times.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">\"A mentor can encourage you and help you overcome the inevitable crises that one encounters on a genuine artistic journey,\" emphasizes David. A mentor who understands the emotional rollercoaster of the creative process can be immensely reassuring. Whether it’s helping you push through a creative block or offering a fresh perspective, mentors are there to remind you of your potential when self-doubt creeps in.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/009da8ad-b043-485c-93f0-ebfd94899392.jpg?width=3000&height=4243&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"E8b87674853095.5c3c9a3792833\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/74853095\/The-Tiger-and-The-Dragon\">The Tiger and The Dragon by David Sossella and Fresh Pencil<\/a><\/h4>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">Mentorship is a Two Way Street <\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Mentorship benefits both the mentor and the mentee. For Stefan, mentoring provides inspiration and creative growth: “I am constantly inspired by the work of the designers that I collaborate with, by the mindset of my clients and by the passion of the students that I help guide. Sometimes, students become collaborators, and your network keeps expanding.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">“What I find particularly rewarding is how mentorship has expanded beyond my immediate circle, especially with the ease of connecting online,” adds Teti. “Getting to know new people—often incredibly gifted and beautifully vulnerable in their talent—while helping them find confidence and guiding them through challenges in their creative journey makes me truly happy.” <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/61d5318c-871a-4951-bcf7-258b073f2740.jpg?width=1151&height=1645&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"488a38182468411.656c6fb49f93c\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/182468411\/Silkscreen-Zurich-City-Poster\">Silkscreen Zurich City Poster by Teti Kartasheva<\/a><\/h4>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">Find a Creative Mentor on Behance<\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">If you’re feeling stuck or are ready to take your career to the next level, Behance is the best place to find a creative mentor. “The greatest source of artistic inspiration beyond doubt has been the Behance community, from which I have had so much to learn over the years. Being in a community of people with the same passion is critical to improving your art,” says Stefan. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/search\/projects\">Search<\/a> by creative field or location to see artists whose portfolios resonate with you, or browse freelancers offering <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/hire\/browse?category=mentorship-and-career-advice\">mentorship services<\/a>. As Stefan advises, “Be open and form connections, and ask for feedback from people who you respect.”  <\/p>\n<p><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/pro\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/e1dba251-8d5e-4ee4-a8fb-03dfd4791346.png?width=2106&height=399&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Blog Banner\"><\/a><\/p>"},{"id":1818,"slug":"kate-anto","title":"Artist Spotlight: Kate Anto","updatedOn":"2024-09-30T18:43:40.500Z","publishedOn":"2024-09-26T02:00:00.000Z","summary":"How graphic designer Kate Anto forged her creative career through persistence and dedication to continued learning.","status":"published","keywords":[],"categories":[{"label":"Artist Spotlight","slug":"artist-spotlight"}],"featuredImage":{"author":"Kate Anto","authorUrl":"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/170565623\/MOON-Creative-Lab-Annual-Report","sourceProject":"Moon Creative Lab Annual Report","sourceProjectUrl":"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/kateanto","behanceUrl":null,"id":"b11eb64d-5896-43d7-89d3-f841b1a82ae1","imageUrl":"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/b11eb64d-5896-43d7-89d3-f841b1a82ae1?format=webp&quality=90","alt":"Kate Anto: Moon Creative Lab Annual Report"},"content":"<p>“As a little kid, I spent all my free time drawing,” recalls graphic designer Ekaterina Antoniuk, who goes by <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/kateanto\">Kate Anto<\/a> on Behance. “I wanted to become an artist, and my most desired birthday gift was a brand-new pack of pencils.”<\/p>\n<div id=\"user-summary-target-1726607191022\" class=\"beComponents\" data-becomponent=\"miniprofile\" data-userid=\"1724119\"><\/div>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Kate’s financial circumstances did not allow her to attend design school after graduating from high school. Instead, she chose a journalism school that was affordable and gave her the flexibility to work and pursue design courses on the side. “I put together some work for my portfolio and landed my first design job in my second year of university. Later, my company sponsored me to attend a graphic design school.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/05e77885-6285-4307-8cdf-423cabfb6bd4.png?width=3840&height=2453&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Harman\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/107864229\/Harman-Kardon-Packaging-Guideline\">Harman Kardon Packaging Guideline by Kate Anto, Bratislav Vidanovic, Aron del Mundo, Rafał Czaniecki, and Aina Cecilie Moen<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">A pivotal moment in Kate’s career was when she was scouted by an American consumer electronics company based in China to join their team in Shenzhen. “It was a completely new experience for me, working with people from all over the world and on brands that are sold globally,” she recalls. “Moving across countries and industries has really shaped my design style and perspective, and I love seeing how design connects with different cultures”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">In 2020, Kate decided to follow her husband and move to Japan. She continued to work with the company based in China on a freelance basis, which encouraged her to ultimately pursue freelancing full time. “When I moved to Japan, finding a full-time job that fit my background was tough since the market was so different,” explains Kate. “Freelancing felt like the natural next step, giving me the freedom to work on projects that align with my skills and interests.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/fe97c8c7-6f9e-4b46-a3ac-8e76186bd6ba.jpg?width=3200&height=2221&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Auman\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/126602225\/AUMANN-fashion-branding\">AUMANN fashion branding by Kate Anto<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Kate's earlier years as an in-house designer has influenced her approach as a freelance designer. “I learned how to stay organized and manage my schedule when I have multiple ongoing projects,” she explains. As a former art director, Kate is able to keep her focus on the bigger picture and provide extended consultations to her clients. “This is especially helpful when I’m working on a startup project and the client isn’t quite sure what they should do before or after the brand identity.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/c2d2af2d-2f0d-4ce2-b3e7-218f82c5d9d7.png?width=2800&height=1800&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Mon2\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/170565623\/MOON-Creative-Lab-Annual-Report\">Moon Creative Lab Annual Report by Kate Anto<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">One of Kate’s biggest challenges transitioning into a life of freelance was flying solo. “Many clients expect you to handle everything, which was intimidating at first,” she says. In order to broaden her skills and client base, Kate took courses in UI and visual designs, and plans to continue developing this skill set in the future. “Flexibility is key — it not only helps you grow but also makes you more attractive to clients.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/ad638016-7c77-4001-80c0-8f0397d726ee.png?width=2800&height=1750&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"4f307c140352917.6240692accf88\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/140352917\/Art-History-App-UIUX-Design\">Art History App UIUX Design by Kate Anto<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Despite her busy schedule, Kate has always prioritized learning and exploration to expand her creative horizons: “I work on multiple projects at a time, so staying organized is important, but I also make time to explore design trends, take short courses, and collaborate with other creatives. Of course, Behance has been my main source of inspiration for more than a decade.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/e3d24388-1b21-40f3-acad-cae1c0480321.jpg?width=3840&height=2560&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Cleer\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/110862251\/CLEER-AUDIO-BRAND-VISUALIZATION\">CLEER AUDIO BRAND VISUALIZATION by Kate Anto, Daniela Toledo Escárate, and Lawrence Anthony Pontillas<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Behance has been a key building block in Kate’s freelance career. ’“Behance has been my go-to platform for finding clients. I’ve completed more projects this year than ever before, and they’ve been incredibly diverse in style, industry, and scale. This diversity has helped boost my creativity, allowing me to view things from different angles and master various visual styles.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/cd2f6785-b5df-4509-9bf8-80e95479cda9.jpg?width=2800&height=1381&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"35c770133245455.61b95e3b8a680\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/133245455\/SWEET-audio-branding\">Sweet Audio Branding by Kate Anto<\/a> <\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">One project in particular, <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/133245455\/SWEET-audio-branding\">Sweet Audio Branding<\/a> received nearly 10,000 views on Behance and caught the eyes of several clients. \"They often reference its colorful yet clean style when they reach out,” Kate says. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Even smaller, less lucrative projects have proven to be meaningful for Kate after sharing them to Behance: ”I didn’t earn much from the <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/129723837\/SEUNOTO-Branding\">Seunoto<\/a> project, but it led to a lot of exposure, two features on Behance, and new clients, which made it worth it.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/9c70a6a1-c929-4716-b4be-fd4255ad8973.jpg?width=3840&height=2400&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Seunoto\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/129723837\/SEUNOTO-Branding\">Seunoto by Kate Anto<\/a> <\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Positive reviews on her profile have also been instrumental in attracting new clients. “Those reviews really help with visibility. I’ve noticed that every time I finish a project and get a review, new inquiries usually follow.” Kate also emphasizes consistency: “I try to keep my portfolio fresh by regularly adding meaningful projects and staying active on the platform.”<\/p>\n<div id=\"service-card-target-1726162475998\" class=\"beComponents\" data-becomponent=\"service\" data-username=\"kateanto\" data-serviceid=\"281433\"><\/div>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">When it comes to pricing her creative services, Kate says “it’s all about finding a balance between value and fairness.” “I consider my experience, the market, the client’s size, and my own expenses. I charge more for larger companies and sometimes lower rates for startups or projects that excite me,” she explains. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">As a <a href=\"http:\/\/behance.net\/pro\">Behance Pro<\/a> member, Kate has taken advantage of 0% platform fees and advanced analytics to improve her portfolio: “I love Behance Pro, especially the analytics feature — it’s great for tweaking my portfolio and hashtags.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/619ffcde-c69f-497b-a226-047c4d317444.jpg?width=3840&height=2560&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Itsumo\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/65128121\/ITSUMO-fashion-branding\">ITSUMO fashion branding by Kate Anto<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Looking ahead to the year ahead, Kate plans to continue building relationships with clients, turning the new leads from this year into long-term projects. “Behance will definitely play a role in that, helping me showcase my work and connect with potential clients.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/kateanto\">See more work by Kate on Behance.<\/a><\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/pro\" target=\"_self\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/7affec03-b336-4495-a517-c3c1a4933dce.png?width=2106&height=399&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Blog Banner\"> <\/a><\/p>"},{"id":1817,"slug":"art-of-mooncake-packaging","title":"The Art of Mooncake Packaging","updatedOn":"2024-09-16T17:18:27.791Z","publishedOn":"2024-09-16T20:00:00.000Z","summary":"Celebrate Mid-Autumn festival with inspiring mooncake packaging design projects from the Behance community. ","status":"published","keywords":[],"categories":[{"label":"Inspiration","slug":"inspiration"}],"featuredImage":{"author":"the Behance Team","authorUrl":"behance.net\/behance","sourceProject":"Mid-Autumn Festival moodboard","sourceProjectUrl":"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/moodboard\/196163539\/Mid-Autumn-Festival","behanceUrl":null,"id":"1be486b2-1872-42fc-8540-2d042d73d9a8","imageUrl":"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/1be486b2-1872-42fc-8540-2d042d73d9a8?format=webp&quality=90","alt":"the Behance Team: Mid-Autumn Festival moodboard"},"content":"<p dir=\"ltr\">Mooncakes are a beloved tradition during the Mid-Autumn Festival, a time when families and friends gather to celebrate the harvest. These delicacies are more than just a tasty treat; they symbolize unity and are often exchanged as gifts to convey well-wishes and gratitude.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/9a99fd62-767d-4d4e-9ade-e4e4be9454bf.jpg?width=1920&height=1278&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Paper Play\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/139466791\/PaperPlay-Moon-cake-gift-box\">Moon cake gift box by Paper Play<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Mooncake packaging offers a unique canvas for creativity — an opportunity to honor tradition and embrace innovation. This thoughtful approach to design not only enhances the product's appeal but also plays a crucial role in influencing consumer choices. “Mooncakes are usually given as a meaningful gift as a way to pay gratitude to others. The design of the box is the most important point for everyone to consider before buying a set,” says Andy Ho, founder and executive creative director of <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/bracomagencyvn\">Bracom Agency<\/a>. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">From elegant and ornate designs to innovative and contemporary applications, we dive into the intricate and elegant world of mooncake packaging designs created by Behance members around the world. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/065168bf-ab0b-49b1-8768-f230be398e3b.gif?width=1440&height=960&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"8063a4113076133.602102f2aa16e\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/113076133\/2020-XD-Mooncake-Packaging-Design-\">2020 XD Mooncake Packaging Design by XD DESIGN, JO JO, KIRA Oy, and 殷 梦婷<\/a><\/h4>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">Blending Tradition and Modernity<\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">For graphic designer and illustrator <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/ichyichang\">I Chyi Chang<\/a>, the essence of Mid-Autumn Festival is “reunion, a time to be with loved ones.” “For me, the Mid-Autumn Festival has always been a special time spent with family since childhood,” she recalls. “We gather in the evening for a big meal, and as night falls and the moon rises, the whole family goes up to the roof to enjoy mooncakes sent by relatives, sipping tea and chatting.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">“The Mid-Autumn Festival is rich with folklore that many people are familiar with,” says I Chyi. “Transforming these stories into easily recognizable visual symbols helps create an immediate emotional connection and resonance with consumers when they see the packaging.” <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/b4b58507-8162-48f8-8feb-40bfde6ef3cc.png?width=3870&height=2664&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Frame 2\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/204828419\/Quelques-Patisseries-2023-Moon-Festival\">Quelques Pâtisseries 2023 Moon Festival by I Chyi Chang<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">In her packaging for <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/204828419\/Quelques-Patisseries-2023-Moon-Festival\">Quelques Pâtisseries<\/a>, I Chyi weaves contemporary typography with images of rabbits and the moon that are inspired by traditional Chinese painting. “By combining traditional elements with modern visual art techniques, such as geometric shapes and fluorescent colors, the design achieves a natural blend of tradition and contemporary visual language, maintaining a sense of both tradition and modernity,” she explains. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/550cac1d-6d56-4b2b-bb02-bbdb15bc398a.jpg?width=2000&height=3000&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Mosi\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/138934359\/Mosi-Inclusive-Mooncake\">Mosi Inclusive Mooncake by Frank Lo and Comma Leung <\/a><\/h4>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">Balancing Brand and Heritage<\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Many businesses commission custom mooncakes to gift to clients during the Mid-Autumn festival, which requires designers to balance not only cultural history and contemporary design, but also brand elements. “When working on packaging design projects for culturally significant products like mooncakes, the most important aspect is how to subtly highlight the brand's concept while conveying the beautiful meaning of the festival,” says <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/auchonhin\">Au Chon Hin<\/a>, creative director at untitled macaco.  <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/9fa7222c-bf86-47eb-a012-dcfbc8020084.jpg?width=3840&height=2560&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Treasure Box of the Moon\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/150151095\/Treasure-Box-of-The-Moon-Grand-Lisboa-Hotel\">Treasure Box of The Moon - Grand Lisboa Hotel by Au Chon Hin<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">For the <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/150151095\/Treasure-Box-of-The-Moon-Grand-Lisboa-Hotel\">Grand Lisboa Hotel<\/a>, Au Chon and untitled macao incorporated circular shapes and goldfish to create a unique modern take on mooncake packaging and convey the theme of reunion. Their design combines the client’s brand color, green, with gold, an auspicious color in Asian culture. The goldfish symbolize family, and the ripples are inspired by the hotel’s spherical architecture. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/ed9db4fe-3aee-4fd9-ac96-b52fecda3807.png?width=1400&height=1400&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"8c1b90178209307.64e4555693df8\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/178209307\/CHEESE-COFFEES-MOONCAKE-PACKAGING\">CHEESE COFFEE’S MOONCAKE PACKAGING by Navigator Studio, TRONGTRAN DESIGN, PA Nguyen, and hp ovo<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">When <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/tsubakistudio\">TSUBAKI<\/a>’s client Teatime by Thien created mooncake jellies in lieu of the traditional pastry, they created equally avant garde packaging to compliment the unconventional treat. To reflect the translucent nature of jelly, the studio used acrylic and pastel colors to create the custom packaging. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">“The unique aspect of this packaging is its functionality; we incorporated a built-in handle within the box, eliminating the need for a separate carry bag,” explains Jay Lim, creative director at TSUBAKI. “This allows consumers to easily carry the box to any destination, effectively serving as a form of advertising.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/8ce01c9c-75d4-477a-8e52-31915a84782e.png?width=3870&height=2664&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Frame 1\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/151391395\/Teatime-by-Thien-Mooncake-Packaging-Design\">Teatime by Thien Mooncake Packaging Design by TSUBAKI Kuala Lumpur<\/a><\/h4>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">Unique Structures and Concepts <\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">To stand out from the crowd, many brands have begun requesting mooncake packaging designs with unique structures and concepts that will delight their customers. For their client W Gourmet, Andy and his team at <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/bracomagencyvn\">Bracom<\/a> created an elegant “moon box” containing a meticulously crafted moon that lights up.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/fca97a93-b6e7-47b1-a3bc-f3e34e0876ad.png?width=3840&height=2160&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Bracom\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/178824669\/The-Moons-Celebration\">The Moon's Celebration by Bracom Agency, R-Duy Tran, and Minh Double<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">“The ethereal scene of the Mid-Autumn night, where the heavens meet the earth, is encapsulated within the design of the \"moon box.\" The moon's image, observed from above, is creatively reconstructed through lenses and design language,” explains Andy. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">The elegant velvet box features stamped and embossed gold foil and a transparent lid that evokes a precious jewelry box or a museum exhibit. After the festival, the moon box becomes a durable keepsake for the recipient. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/ebe479bf-f7f6-4909-88fc-8503d8ece8e8.png?width=2251&height=1501&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"5edee2151942069.631591ab7a1e6\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/151942069\/Packaging-\">Packaging by Oneday Design<\/a><\/h4>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">Trends in Mooncake Packaging Design <\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Despite their deep roots in tradition, mooncakes are undergoing a transformation, evolving to meet contemporary tastes and preferences. “In recent years, mooncake packaging has increasingly focused on environmental sustainability, evident in the simplification of packaging, the choice of materials, and the reusability of the packaging,” says Au Chon. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/740e84d0-5aaf-4a4d-a575-2bdad1a410fe.png?width=3870&height=2664&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Frame 3\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/83587577\/BAO-BEI-Mooncake-Box-Packaging-2019\">BAO BEI - Mooncake Box Packaging 2019 by Danny 黃<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">In the years to come, Jay expects to see even more experimentation with materials and incorporation of interactive elements, and Andy foresees more consideration for repurposing boxes after the festivities to lessen the environmental impact. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">The future promises a continued journey towards creative and sustainable solutions, with designs that not only honor cultural heritage but also embrace modern values.<\/p>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">Looking for more Mid-Autumn Festival projects? <\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/search\/projects?search=mid%20autumn%20festival%20&tracking_source=typeahead_nav_direct\">Search for more Mid-Autumn Festival projects<\/a> on Behance or browse more projects from our curated <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/moodboard\/196163539\/Mid-Autumn-Festival\">Mid-Autumn Festival moodboard<\/a>. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" Natsume: Apple: Essential Gamer App | Twitch"},"content":"<p dir=\"ltr\">A portfolio is more than just a catalog of your work. It’s a reflection and extension of you, and oftentimes the first impression you’ll make on potential clients and employers. To be a successful creative, it’s essential to make a strong and lasting impression with our portfolio. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">“A good portfolio also represents your opinion on design, what you think is and is not important. It is the story about the relationship between you and design,” says Mitch Goldstein, Assistant Professor at Rochester Institute of Technology’s School of Design.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">We’ve gathered tips from Mitch and seasoned freelancers on Behance to help you craft a portfolio that showcases your skills and experience, and communicates your unique creative vision.<\/p>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">1. Show your best work<\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">When it comes to portfolios, less is sometimes more. Focus on quality over quantity and select a few standout projects that showcase your skills and attention to detail. Resist the temptation to add sub-par work just to fill up space; it’s better to have five knockout projects than ten mediocre ones. Remember that your portfolio will only ever be as strong as your weakest project. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">“A strong portfolio is crucial as it demonstrates an artist’s ability to potential clients and employers.” says Enrico Siket, owner and creative director of <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/brandnw\">BRAND ᴺᵂ<\/a>, a multi-disciplinary design studio based in Germany. “We look for portfolios that include a variety of projects, clear descriptions of the artist’s role, and evidence of strategic thinking.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/757ddc29-b124-49fe-9931-e71777959a57.jpg?width=1400&height=1095&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Brandnw\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/184924949\/SEVA-SKINCARE\">SEVA SKINCARE by BRAND ᴺᵂ and Daniela Martínez<\/a><\/h4>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">2. Consider what you want to be hired for<\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Think about the kind of work you want to do more of, and showcase projects that best represent that desired niche. If there’s work you’d like to do less of, omit those to set yourself up for the right opportunities that aligns with your goals. “It’s important to display relevant work and skills for the role. Including too many projects can overwhelm a portfolio; instead, focus on a curated selection of your best work,” advises Enrico. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/updates\/get-hired-on-behance-with-services\">List a Creative Service <\/a>on Behance to let clients know up front what kind of work you want to be hired for. Set your own price, timeline, and revisions to get qualified leads, and get paid safely and securely directly on Behance. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/9decdc72-c105-499e-9d30-1722ec2ea612.png?width=3345&height=1929&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Alexandre\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/AlexandrePietra\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">Browse Creative Services by Alexandre Pietra<\/a><\/h4>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">3. Demonstrate versatility <\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Versatility is critical in a creative portfolio because it demonstrates to potential clients that you’re able to adapt to a range of different styles, mediums, and projects. Even if you are specializing in a particular niche, you can still show variety by including a range of examples that have different styles, audiences, and applications. This approach highlights your ability to tailor your work to specific client needs while maintaining your unique creative identity.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><video controls=\"controls\" width=\"300\" height=\"150\"><source src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/a99ce71d-4181-4b85-8c6a-d1028dc50281&format=webp&quality=90\" type=\"video\/mp4\"><\/video><\/p>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">4. Document your process and design thinking <\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Showing your process demonstrates your problem-solving skills and thought process, helping potential clients understand how you develop solutions and bring ideas to life. Include a concise summary for each project that describes the scope of your work. Additionally, you can document your approach to offer a deeper understanding of your creative workflow.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">“Practically every project I post attracts new clients,” says designer <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/leonatsume\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">Leo Natsume<\/a>. “That's why I always strive to create well-thought-out presentations that give potential clients a clear understanding of what I do. I detail the production stages, show how the work was done, and highlight the final deliverables.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><video controls=\"controls\" width=\"300\" height=\"150\"><source src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/2665cc6d-5b4f-49f7-808c-b61417a3abcc&format=webp&quality=90\" type=\"video\/mp4\"><\/video><\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">“The portfolio itself might be what gets you in the door, but the conversation about what you did and why you did it gets you the job. Make sure that you are able to justify your decisions and explain your choices,” says Mitch. Writing about your work and reflecting on your process also serves as good practice for future interviews. <\/p>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">5. Represent you<\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">“Companies and clients do not hire a portfolio; they hire a person, therefore it is important that you are represented in your portfolio,” says Mitch. Curating a balanced mix of client projects and personal pieces can highlight your unique point of view and skill set. While client work reflects your experience working with clients, self-initiated projects can showcase your interest beyond commercial endeavors. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Investing and exploring your own creative interests can have a rewarding professional payoff. 3D artist <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/dannyivan\">Danny Ivan<\/a> was fascinated by glass textures and even traveled to Murano, Italy to see how glass was made in person. He reinterpreted the age-old art form into digital and 3D art, and these projects helped him attract technology and hardware companies who were looking to create captivating campaigns with abstract visuals. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/083d5446-0120-4411-a1a3-a87b22b1e3f3.jpg?width=1400&height=1980&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Danny\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/154269191\/Melted-3D-Glass\">Melted 3D glass by Danny Ivan<\/a><\/h4>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">6. Focus on the work<\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Your work should always be the focal point of your portfolio. Use high quality, high resolution images in a clean, uncluttered layout. Avoid overwhelming your portfolio with unnecessary design elements or too much text—let the work speak for itself. Make sure your contact information is up to date and easily discoverable so prospective clients can contact you. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">As a <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/pro\">Behance Pro<\/a> member, you can <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/blog\/profile-customizations\">personalize your Behance profile<\/a> to include a custom button, turn on dark theme, and manage the visibility of public areas of your profile. If you work across multiple disciplines, creating <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/blog\/pro-profile-sections-image-search\">sections<\/a> in your profile can help clients navigate your portfolio. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/23ebe613-e8b1-4a33-9f66-efd5ac1109e3.png?width=3345&height=1929&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Danny\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/dannyivan\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">See Danny Ivan's personalized Behance profile<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Your Pro membership also includes access to <a href=\"http:\/\/portfolio.adobe.com\">Adobe Portfolio<\/a> so you can build your own custom website and have full control over the look and feel of your portfolio.  <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/pro\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/ea52a492-582d-4361-9910-066476a2f08b.png?width=1765&height=172&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Trial Button\"><\/a><\/p>\n<h2 dir=\"ltr\">7. Update projects regularly  <\/h2>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">A portfolio is a living, breathing entity. As you evolve as a creative, so should your portfolio. In addition to keeping it up to date with new projects, remove any projects as they become less relevant to the type of work you aspire to get. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/88597aa9-5f34-4b6f-9c0e-caae5a509e3b.jpg?width=1400&height=1013&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Tatiana Vovchek\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/151189897\/Lost-fairy\">Lost fairy by Tatiana Vovchek<\/a><\/h4>\n<p>Freelance illustrator <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/tvovchek\/projects\">Tatiana Vovchek<\/a> has been using Behance as her portfolio for over 12 years. In the early days of her career, her portfolio was largely UI\/UX projects. Later, as she pivoted to illustration, she began showcasing her watercolor art. These days, her portfolio has been updated with vector art and book illustration projects. “Updating my portfolio is a habit for me and I recommend everyone unpublish outdated projects and find time to showcase new projects and tell their story of creation,” says Tatiana. <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/pro\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/0b5bd3e3-ea50-44e9-8a60-837c1e1e5a4f.png?width=2106&height=399&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Blog Banner\"><\/a><\/p>"},{"id":1791,"slug":"download-templates-mockups-behance","title":"The Designer's Toolkit: Essential Templates & Mockups for Creative Projects","updatedOn":"2024-08-28T18:40:39.117Z","publishedOn":"2024-09-04T17:58:00.000Z","summary":"Take your designs to the next level with our curated collection of high-quality templates, including mock ups, presentations, social media kits, presentations, and more.","status":"published","keywords":[],"categories":[{"label":"Assets","slug":"assets"}],"featuredImage":{"author":"Artified™ Mockups","authorUrl":"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/artdiremockups","sourceProject":"City Billboard Mockups ","sourceProjectUrl":"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/204216571\/City-Billboard-Mockups","behanceUrl":null,"id":"d9dd21e4-a044-49b4-a27c-4c7bfe586126","imageUrl":"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/d9dd21e4-a044-49b4-a27c-4c7bfe586126?format=webp&quality=90","alt":"Artified™ Mockups: City Billboard Mockups "},"content":"<p dir=\"ltr\">Design templates are invaluable resources for creative professionals. From vibrant identity and logo designs to eye-catching social media designs, Alexandra creates memorable visual experiences that are as bold and colorful as the brands they represent.<\/p>\n<div id=\"user-summary-target-1724691711115\" class=\"beComponents\" data-becomponent=\"miniprofile\" data-userid=\"111489797\"><\/div>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">While studying graphic design in El Salvador, Alexandra started sharing her university projects to her <a href=\"https:\/\/www.instagram.com\/othersbyalex\">Instagram account<\/a> where she found a community of creatives who challenged her with weekly design projects. “That's when I started practicing and perfecting my style, having fun, and finding my own creative identity.”<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/5abc7167-2012-4c82-af1d-7b708d038b77.jpg?width=3840&height=2160&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Nice People\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/201225425\/Nice-Headshots-Branding-design\">Nice Headshots - Branding design by Alexandra Pacheco<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Alexandra describes the discovery of her creative voice as a “deeply personal journey that unfolded over time,” and Behance has been an integral part of that process. “Behance is an awesome source of inspiration,” she shares. “Engaging with this platform has been instrumental in fueling my own creative drive, and I aspire to reciprocate by inspiring other creators through my projects as well.” <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">In the earlier part of her career, Alexandra shared her personal projects to Behance, and eventually expanded the scope to client work. These days, she’s finding new clients and selling digital assets to benefit other creators on the platform, while balancing her full-time role as a graphic designer at Unilever.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/7955d57e-4adb-4562-a70c-38c7cf7ffcf1.png?width=1722&height=1310&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Sense of Burger\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/161071315\/Sense-of-Buger-Logo-and-branding\">Sense of Burger - Logo and branding by Alexandra Pacheco<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Through these multiple creative income streams, Alexandra has found not only financial gain, but also diverse opportunities for personal growth and artistic exploration. “These different streams complement each other, providing me with a well-rounded and fulfilling professional experience,” she says.<\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/11a99766-3ecd-4596-a73b-778550c48e4d.jpg?width=3840&height=2160&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Flo\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/191785989\/Relax-youre-not-overreacting-Flo-App-Campaign\">\"Relax, you're not overreacting\" Flo App - Campaign by Alexandra Pacheco<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">“I love my corporate job at Unilever. It provides me stability and allows me to apply my skills in a structured environment, but it can sometimes be limiting in terms of creative freedom,” Alexandra reflects. “On the other hand, freelancing gives me the freedom to explore my creativity and help business owners bring their brand visions to life.” The downside is that freelancing can be unpredictable. <\/p>\n<div id=\"service-card-target-1724693669094\" class=\"beComponents\" data-becomponent=\"service\" data-username=\"alegpacheco\" data-serviceid=\"262335\"><\/div>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">In addition to her full time job and freelance projects, Alexandra sells assets on Behance: “Selling assets is a great way for me to share my work with a wider audience and generate passive income.” <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Creating her own portfolio project was particularly meaningful for Alexandra as a journey of self rediscovery. “Looking back at my first projects alongside the most recent ones brings me joy. Many times, when I’m having a bad creative day or feeling the weight of imposter syndrome, looking back at my portfolio makes me smile.” <\/p>\n<div id=\"project-target-1724693724609\" class=\"beComponents\" data-becomponent=\"project\" data-projectid=\"197966707\"><\/div>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Understanding the importance of portfolios, Alexandra created templates and has been offering them through the Behance assets marketplace. “It’s inspiring to see how significant it has been not only for me but also for other creatives. This motivates me to keep learning and improving day by day.” <\/p>\n<p dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: justify;\"><img loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https:\/\/blog-assets.behance.net\/assets\/55299fd7-4ac1-4a9e-b15d-dd1e3a11e840.jpg?width=3818&height=2145&format=webp&quality=90\" alt=\"Fifa\"><\/p>\n<h4 dir=\"ltr\"><a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/gallery\/169967281\/FIFA-WORLD-CUP-EL-SALVADOR-2030\">FIFA WORLD CUP EL SALVADOR 2030 by Alexandra Pacheco, Danny Guez, Camila Campos, Melanie Flores, Maria Monterroza<\/a><\/h4>\n<p dir=\"ltr\">Since upgrading to <a href=\"https:\/\/www.behance.net\/pro\">Behance Pro<\/a>, Alexandra has taken advantage of advanced analytics to improve her asset sales. “One of my favorite features is the statistics tool, which has provided invaluable insights into my audience's preferences and current interests. This understanding has guided my asset creation decisions,” she says. Freelancer","updatedOn":"2024-08-15T17:22:22.885Z","publishedOn":"2024-08-21T01:00:00.000Z","summary":"Rejection is a difficult challenge to overcome,  but with the right mindset, it can become a
